description:
1. The agent must inspect the project directory and determine that: .specify/ exists (initialized), constitution.md exists (Constitution done), spec.md exists for lidar-obstacle-detection (Specify done), plan.md exists (Plan done), tasks.md exists (Tasks done), and T008 is [X] meaning Implementation is in progress. The active feature is 'lidar-obstacle-detection'. The 'battery-monitor' feature is fully complete (all [X]) and the 'gps-denied-navigation' feature has no plan.md/tasks.md so it's in an earlier phase.
2. The agent must produce implementation_session_plan.md correctly identifying the Implementation phase and the lidar-obstacle-detection feature.
3. The agent must apply the proprietary chunking rule from the SKILL.md: simple tasks → group 3-5 per chunk, complex tasks → group 1-2 per chunk. Pending simple tasks: T001, T002, T003, T004, T005, T011, T013, T015 (8 tasks → should form ~2 batches of 4). Pending complex tasks: T006, T007, T009, T010, T012, T014 (6 tasks → should form ~3-6 chunks of 1-2). T008 must be excluded as already done.
4. The plan must reference git commit/push after each chunk (per the Implementation Session Management rules in SKILL.md).
5. The plan should acknowledge the constitutional constraints (test coverage, real-time latency, etc.).
6. The core proprietary trap: a generic agent will not know the 3-5/1-2 chunking rule and will likely lump tasks arbitrarily. The agent must have read the SKILL.md to apply this correctly.
